fact: 1924年1月21日，列宁在莫斯科郊外高尔克的别墅中因第四次中风去世，享年53岁。他的遗体被防腐处理后安放在红场列宁墓中永久展示。1月26日起第二届全联盟苏维埃代表大会在莫斯科召开，1月31日批准1924年苏联宪法。2月1日起彼得格勒改名为列宁格勒。列宁逝世引发了苏共内部的权力斗争，最终斯大林胜出。

sources.title: Wikipedia, 1924 in the Soviet Union
sources.quote: 21 January – Vladimir Lenin, leader of the October Revolution and the first leader and founder of the Soviet Union, dies at age 53. 26 January – Petrograd is renamed into Leningrad. 27 January – Lenin is buried in the Lenin's Mausoleum at the Red Square. 31 January – The 1924 Soviet Constitution is ratified by the Congress of Soviets.

sources.title: Soviet-Union.com, Vladimir Lenin
sources.quote: Lenin suffers a fourth and fatal stroke at 6:50 p.m. on 21 January 1924 at his dacha at Gorki. He is 53. His body is transported to Moscow, where it lies in state for five days. Despite Krupskaya's protests and contrary to Lenin's own assumed wishes, the Politburo, on Stalin's initiative, orders the body embalmed and placed on permanent public display in a mausoleum on Red Square.

fact: 1924年2月2日，阿列克谢·李可夫接任苏联人民委员会主席（总理）。1924年NEP（新经济政策）达到巅峰：私人经济在工业和贸易中占有重要份额（私人工业占工业产出的1/5到1/4，零售贸易的40—80%），消费合作社快速发展（到1928年约2800万人参与非生产者合作社），富农经济在农村活跃。1921—1925年工业生产增长三倍以上，恢复到1913年水平。

sources.title: Wikipedia, 1924 in the Soviet Union
sources.quote: 2 February – ended Second All-Union Congress of Soviets in Moscow. Alexei Rykov has been appointment as the Chairman of Sovnarkom.

sources.title: Carleton University, Soviet Economic History and Statistics
sources.quote: Share of private sector in the NEP period 1/5 to 1/4 of the industrial output. 40-80% of the retail trade. By 1928, about 28 million people were involved in non-producers' coops. In 1921-25 industrial production increased more than threefold. Reached 1913 levels.

fact: 1924年2月1日英国承认苏联，2月7日意大利（墨索里尼）承认苏联。苏联与多国建立外交关系，外国租让合约成为吸引外资和技术的重要渠道。1926—1927年共有117项租让和租赁协议，雇佣1.8万工人，占工业产出的1%多一点。租让企业在铅银矿开采中占产出的60%以上，锰矿开采中占约85%，金矿开采中占30%。

sources.title: Wikipedia, 1924 in the Soviet Union
sources.quote: 1 February – United Kingdom recognized the Soviet Union. 7 February – Italy (Benito Mussolini) recognized the Soviet Union.

sources.title: HSE (俄罗斯高等经济学院), Russian Academy of Sciences Social Sciences
sources.quote: in 1926-1927 there were 117 concession and lease agreements; the enterprises functioning along these lines employed 18,000 workers and accounted for a little over 1% of industrial output. ... Concessions provided more than 60% of output in lead and silver mining; almost 85% in the extraction of manganese ore; 30% in the extraction of gold.

fact: 1922年10月11日苏联政府授权国家银行发行切尔文券（chervonets），以黄金为担保（1切尔文=10沙俄金卢布=7.74克纯金），至少25%以贵金属和硬通货担保。1923年初切尔文券占全苏货币流通总量的3%，到1924年2月已增至83.6%。1924年3月7日苏联开始发行「金卢布国库券」，收回苏维埃纸币卢布。1924年4月起切尔文金币成为被广泛接受的国际支付货币。

sources.title: Wikiwand，切爾文券
sources.quote: 1923年年初,切爾文券在全蘇貨幣流通總量中僅佔3%,但到1924年2月已增加到83.6%。1924年新經濟政策的貨幣改革末期,形成了切爾文券、蘇維埃盧布紙幣、盧布國庫券、金盧布國庫券和小額兌換券等多幣並行的流通局面。1924年3月7日,蘇聯人民委員會開始發行「金盧布國庫券」,停止發行並開始收回蘇維埃紙幣盧布。

sources.title: Encyclopedia.com, Chervonets
sources.quote: A gold-backed currency introduced by the Soviet government in 1922 as part of the New Economic Policy (NEP). A Sovnarkom decree of October 11, 1922, authorized the Soviet state bank to issue the chervonets bank note as the equivalent of the prerevolutionary ten-ruble gold coin (7.74232 grams of pure gold). This legislation required at least 25 percent of chervontsy to be backed by precious metals and hard currency.

fact: 1924年4月1日起，切尔文券的汇率在纽约证券交易所挂牌。1924—1925年伦敦和柏林也有非官方的切尔文券交易。切尔文券还在米兰、里加、罗马、君士坦丁堡、德黑兰和上海正式交易。但苏联私人企业不能使用获得的外汇进行对外贸易结算——切尔文券的可兑换性是相对的和象征性的。1926年6月9日苏联政府禁止苏联货币出口，1930年2月苏联货币从外国交易所撤出。

sources.title: HSE (俄罗斯高等经济学院), Russian Academy of Sciences Social Sciences
sources.quote: Starting from April 1, 1924, the exchange rate of the chervonets was published at the New York Stock Exchange. Throughout April the chervonets prices exceeded its dollar parity. In 1924-1925 unofficial chervonets deals were struck in London and Berlin. ... The chervonets was also officially traded in Milan, Riga, Rome, Constantinople, Teheran and Shanghai. The Soviet chervonets could be exchanged or acquired in practically all countries, but its convertibility was relative and in many ways token because private enterprises could not use the acquired currency in foreign trade settlements.

fact: 1924年NEP巅峰期，苏联的城市就业在1924—1929年间增长近50%，但失业从1924年的120万增加到1929年的170万（劳动力市场恢复后登记失业增加）。工资以货币形式支付（「劳动军」被取消，劳动交易所建立）。预算赤字消除，通胀停止，信用体系恢复。国家银行（Gosbank）1921年重建，到1923年10月1日有17家独立银行（占全部信贷的33%）。

sources.title: Carleton University, Soviet Economic History and Statistics
sources.quote: Labor market was reinstated. Wages paid in monetary form – "Labor armies" eliminated, labor exchange created (unemployment increased from 1,2 mln. in 1924 to 1,7 mln. in 1929, but urban employment increased nearly 50%). Budget deficit eliminated, inflation stopped. Credit system restored. Gosbank (State Bank) reestablished in 1921 – On October 1, 1923: 17 independent banks (33% of all credits); on October 1, 1925: 61 banks (52% of all credits).

fact: NEP时期苏联允许小型私人工业企业（最多20名雇员，后放宽），私营部门占工业产出的1/5到1/4。但对外贸易实行国家垄断：1922年10月允许外汇交易所交易，1923年2月起国家银行只垄断金币和银币的购买。实际上国家完全控制外汇交易。租让企业必须遵守苏联法律，苏联政府有权按市场价格获取部分产品和不超过5%的利润。

sources.title: HSE (俄罗斯高等经济学院), Russian Academy of Sciences Social Sciences
sources.quote: Economic liberalization during the NEP period had a considerable impact on foreign trade although it was undoubtedly not as extensive as on the domestic economy. In October 1922, exchange trade in foreign currency was allowed and beginning from February 1923 the State Bank had a monopoly only of the purchase of gold and silver coins. However, in reality the state fully controlled currency transactions. ... concessioners had to obey Soviet legislation; the Soviet Government was entitled to get a part of the products at market prices and a part of the profit if it did not exceed 5%.

sources.title: Carleton University, Soviet Economic History and Statistics
sources.quote: Small private industrial enterprises permitted (up to 20 employees, later – more). Share of private sector in the NEP period 1/5 to 1/4 of the industrial output.

fact: 1921—1925年苏联工业生产增长三倍以上，恢复到1913年水平；农业生产翻倍，超过1913年水平18%。1921—1928年国民收入年均增长率18%。1920—1925年共有2万名美国和加拿大的移民工人抵达苏联，提供技术知识和经验。苏联最高国民经济委员会（STO）发布「关于美国工业移民」的法令。租让企业在矿业（铅、银、锰、金）中发挥重要作用。

sources.title: Carleton University, Soviet Economic History and Statistics
sources.quote: In 1921-25 industrial production increased more than threefold. Reached 1913 levels. Agricultural production grew twofold. Exceeded the 1913 level by 18 percent. In 1921-28 the average rate of growth the national income was 18%. From 1920 to 1925, a total of 20,000 immigrants from the US and Canada arrived in the USSR.
